description: Commit history like `git log`, newest first; path, author (substring), since/until and branch (any branch, tag or major such as 17 or 9.6; default the indexed branch) filter. Each commit: sha (cite it), commit_id, message (subject for a branch log), author, dates. has_more.

branch.description: Commits reachable from it (e.g. cf/5556; default the default branch)

name: git_log
